entities.title: Build and test the TypeScript library
entities.summary: Install the one devDependency, then compile and run every test with npm test, from the library's folder.
entities.when: Before changing anything in implementations/typescript, and before committing a change to it.
steps: npm install (installs the only devDependency, typescript 6.0.2, as package-lock.json pins it)
npm test (tsc -p . compiles src/ and test/ into dist/, then node --test runs dist/test/**/*.test.js: the shared fixtures, the typed layer, the examples and native interop)
npm run build compiles without running the tests
entities.verify: npm test passes. The tests read conformance/ from the repository root, so run them inside a full checkout.
entities.details: Toolchain: package.json pins typescript 6.0.2 and names no Node.js version (there is no engines field); tsconfig.json targets ES2022 with NodeNext modules. The README shows only `npm test`; the npm install step is what package.json and package-lock.json require for tsc to exist. The example tests that compare with Intl.DateTimeFormat read the host's tz database, which must know the 2026–2027 rules of New York and Paris.

entities.title: Change a UTV-first example
entities.summary: Regenerate the side-by-side page after changing a test between BEGIN and END task markers.
entities.when: A test in test/examples/utv-first/ wrapped in // BEGIN <task-id> … // END <task-id> has changed.
steps: From the repository root, run python3 tools/side_by_side.py
entities.verify: python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check passes from the repository root.
